status: Requirements intake; original document kept local

existing_implementation.separate_sources: Acoustic and citizen-report metadata; A/B are generic observation channels, not modality-specific sensor physics.
existing_implementation.time: observed_at_ms differs from available_at_ms; delayed records do not replace newer observations.
existing_implementation.health: Offline, stale, invalid measurement and negative observation remain distinct.
existing_implementation.privacy: Synthetic metadata only; no actual audio, video or phone identities.
existing_implementation.transport: Existing HTTP shared replay clock retained; no replacement with the proposed file-per-tick transport.

civilian_modality_requirements.status: Proposed SDR metadata source; not implemented or selected
civilian_modality_requirements.interpretation: Absence of an RF report is not proof of absent aircraft or a specific communications mode.

civilian_modality_requirements.status: Proposed imagery-derived metadata source; not implemented or selected
civilian_modality_requirements.interpretation: No contact is comparable only when time, field of view and measurement quality support the comparison.

proposed_not_implemented.store_and_forward: Delayed receipt simulated; persistent edge buffer and reconnect transport not implemented.
proposed_not_implemented.multimodal_comparison: Requires explicit association, time and coverage compatibility; current zone-level demo is not validated sensor fusion.
proposed_not_implemented.outage_cause: Concurrent outages warrant health review; cause remains unknown rather than confirmed jamming.

freshness_ms.reason: Current 120-second demo retains its separate 30000 ms community and 45000 ms observation thresholds.

proposed_not_implemented.expanded_network: 20 sources and longer replay are document proposals, not current implementation.

unverified_claims: Deployment counts, costs and interception statistics in the document require independent source verification.
Voice-band filtering and metadata-only output do not establish that speech cannot be recovered or that consent is unnecessary.
Repeated detections do not by themselves justify a calibrated confidence increase from 0.3 to 0.8.
radar_spec_scope: Counter-UAS manufacturer references allowed; separate radar_reference_specs.json catalog.
